ModMetaData.name: Creatures of Ki - Teshi Renew
ModMetaData.author: Shooki, Mlie - 1.6 adapted by Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
The teshi from Shooki's Creatures of Ki, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6. An animal from the forest planet Ki, and its eggs.
I am not the author of this mod. The design, the textures and the original idea are Shooki's, and the 1.0 to 1.4 continuation is Mlie's - all I did was the work needed to make the animal run on 1.6. Credit goes to them; mistakes in the update are mine. If either comes back to it, or asks me to take this down, I will.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2726461020
What it adds
- The teshi: a large, bipedal feathered predator with four wide banded ears, a short dark crest and a thick banded tail. The showcase depicts it resting, a pose consistent with its bipedal anatomy. It has claws, a bite worth 25 damage, and it turns manhunter three times in four when harmed. Trainable to intermediate. It nuzzles. It lays eggs, and it lives eighty years. - Teshi eggs. A mated female lays a stack of two fertilized eggs, which take fifteen days to hatch. An unfertilized egg is defined too, as every egg-layer has one, but a teshi does not lay it in normal play. - Found in shrubland, forest, rainforest, boreal forest and tundra, sparsely, and almost never on ice or desert.
What is not included
Creatures of Ki is four fifths a playable race: the Kija, their faction and their name makers, all of which need Humanoid Alien Races. None of that is here, and this mod needs no Humanoid Alien Races. If you want the Kija, use the original.
What changed in the 1.6 update
- Wildness stopped being a race property. In 1.6 it is a Wildness StatDef declared under statBases, and the old form was simply ignored: the teshi tamed as easily as a rat. - The unfertilized egg was missing. Every egg-laying animal in the base game declares one, and the teshi did not. The def was written, taking the market value of its fertilized counterpart. It is declared for parity: a teshi lays a stack of two fertilized eggs, and without a fertilization it does not lay at all.
No balance value was changed.
Compatibility
- A Dog Said... Animal Prosthetics 2: built in. The teshi is in its category 3, the one that holds the bears and the wolves, so it can receive the mod's prosthetic limbs and bionics wherever its body has the matching part. It is an optional integration: this mod needs nothing else, loads before it as that mod asks, and does nothing when it is absent.
Content mod: removing it mid-game will lose any teshi and any teshi eggs already in play.
The source repository includes the changelog and the full list of changes.
Licensed MIT, like the original. The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic). Thanks to Shooki for the animal and to Mlie for keeping it alive to 1.4.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
